Idle filter scratch textures (often 2048x4096) are cleared from Pixi's TexturePool after each burst of bakes

js/textures.js: Pixi 8's Texture.from(url) never loads, so URL textures come from textureFromUrl/sourceFromUrl/loadTexture (one shared, dynamic texture per URL, filled in when the image decodes, @3x resolution from the name, SVG rasterised at width/height or scale); isLoaded/onLoaded/onFailed replace .valid and once('loaded'); frameTexture cuts sheet frames
